purpose: Regression specifications for the historical mall-v1 report. A twin does not itself adjudicate the source; it fixes the minimum semantic evidence and the only permitted terminal outcome when that evidence is observed.

false_positive.source_excerpt: JwtTokenUtil comment says HS512; code invokes Hutool JWTUtil.createToken(claims, key) and JWTUtil.verify(token, key).
required_evidence: exact createToken and verify overload semantics
false_positive.reason: A comment cannot establish the algorithm or the effective cryptographic claim.

true_positive.source_excerpt: application.yml supplies a short source-controlled jwt.secret to JwtTokenUtil.getSigningKey().
required_evidence: resolved verification path uses the configured key
true_positive.reason: A weak key is supportable only after the real verification path and key semantics are resolved.

required_evidence: no Files, Path, or local extraction sink on the claimed flow
bucket authorization and policy analysis are separate
false_positive.reason: A MinIO object key containing ../ is not, by itself, local filesystem traversal.

true_positive.source_excerpt: Files.newOutputStream(base.resolve(userObjectName).normalize()) is used without checking that the resolved path starts with base.
true_positive.reason: A real local filesystem sink turns the path claim into an adjudicable traversal finding.

required_evidence: no logger/audit append sink on this flow
false_positive.reason: A database note is not evidence of a log-forging sink.

true_positive.reason: The user value reaches a real logger record and can affect its interpretation.

false_positive.source_excerpt: OmsMoneyInfoParam is mapped to a new OmsOrder through explicit setFreightAmount and setDiscountAmount calls before updateByPrimaryKeySelective.
required_evidence: sensitive fields absent from the path
false_positive.reason: An explicit DTO-to-entity allowlist breaks a broad mass-assignment claim.

true_positive.source_excerpt: save(@RequestBody Admin entity) { adminMapper.updateByPrimaryKeySelective(entity); } where entity exposes roleId.
true_positive.reason: The request can bind a sensitive field directly into a persistent entity.

false_positive.source_excerpt: A whitelisted registration route creates an account, but the historical chain omits default-role assignment, resource relations, authorities, and route decisions.
false_positive.reason: Unauthenticated registration alone does not prove administrative authorization.

true_positive.source_excerpt: register assigns ROLE_ADMIN; authority loading grants /order/**; the route performs updateMoneyInfo without an additional ownership control.
true_positive.reason: The complete permission graph establishes the claimed privilege transition.

false_positive.source_excerpt: secure.ignored.urls contains /actuator/**, while the historical report has no resolved endpoint enablement, web exposure, profile, management port, or deployment topology.
false_positive.reason: A URL allowlist cannot prove that heapdump is enabled and externally reachable.

true_positive.source_excerpt: management.endpoint.heapdump.enabled=true and management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=heapdump share a public management port with an explicit permitAll security matcher.
true_positive.reason: The configuration establishes an enabled, web-exposed endpoint without an applicable authentication control.

false_positive.source_excerpt: GlobalCorsConfig uses addAllowedOriginPattern("*") and setAllowCredentials(true), but the historical chain omits JWT storage, browser transport, SameSite, sensitive response, and deployment topology.
false_positive.reason: The CORS configuration can be a finding, but it does not alone prove a browser token-theft chain.

true_positive.source_excerpt: A credentialed endpoint reflects arbitrary Origin, session cookies are SameSite=None, and its authenticated JSON response contains account data.
true_positive.reason: The complete browser path establishes cross-origin credentialed data disclosure.

false_positive.source_excerpt: OssCallbackParam declares callbackUrl, callbackBody, and callbackBodyType; the reported filename concatenation has no HTTP client, sendRedirect, Location response, or navigation sink.
required_evidence: HTTP client and redirect sink search
false_positive.reason: A DTO string or URL-shaped concatenation is not SSRF or open redirect without a semantic sink.

true_positive.reason: The controlled destination reaches an HTTP client dispatch sink.
